examples.name: Card
examples.code:
<Card  height="small" width="small" background="light-1">
  <CardHeader pad="medium">Header</CardHeader>
  <CardBody pad="medium">Body</CardBody>
  <CardFooter pad={{horizontal: "small"}} background="light-2">
    <Button
    icon={<Icons.Favorite color="red" />}
    hoverIndicator
    />
    <Button icon={<Icons.ShareOption color="plain" />} hoverIndicator />
  </CardFooter>
</Card>

prose.title: React/DOM Properties
prose.text:
At its core, the Card component is a regular <div> element. Thus, both DOM and React properties, methods, and events are accessible. To read up on all of the possible DOM attributes and types available for div elements, check out this [MDN Web Documents page.](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/div) To learn more about DOM events and methods, you can read more on the [MDN Web Events documentation page](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Events).

Also, feel free to read about the [types of React events available](https://reactjs.org/docs/handling-events.html), or see [how DOM attributes change in React.](https://reactjs.org/docs/dom-elements.html) Working in tandem with Styled Components, you also have access to the [as property.](https://styled-components.com/docs/api#as-polymorphic-prop)

prose.title: CardBody
prose.text:
The body of the card, mostly used for placing content

CardBody is a Box with the following properties preset. You can customize it using the properties available in Box.

- flex: `"true"`
